5. Although informed consent is a contract, it is not an agreement to be injured (45). Nor does informed consent imply that lawsuits are impossible. The informed consent document indicates that the athlete has agreed to participate based on understanding the risks involved.
6. At some point the athlete, parent/guardian must sign the informed consent document and thereby agree to participate or allow the underage child to participate in the activity. The signing of the document indicates that both parties are aware of the risks and choose to participate in spite of the risks. These documents must remain in a file in the event the participant is ever injured. No one should be allowed to participate without an informed consent document on file (45).
